key_findings: Tuina alleviates CCI neuropathic pain by suppressing astrocytic NDRG2 and restoring GLT-1, lowering glutamate and restoring GABA in the spinal dorsal horn.
AAV-NDRG2 overexpression abolished Tuina's effects on glutamate clearance, excitatory synapses and analgesia.
